items.item_text: High School GED General Studies required
Minimum of 3 years of Central Service experience, Sterile Processing, or
1 year of experience and registered CSTechnician/ Sterile Processing Technician.

Must complete assignments assigned daily, including decontamination, sterilization, Prep Room, crash carts, surgery case carts, surgery center core supply carts, equipment, telephone, inventory system (ESI), ordering of inventory or non-inventory supplies. Must demonstrate flexibility by prioritizing tasks to finish assigned assignments.

Must properly relieve inventory from the storage room by properly entering issues into the Materials Management Inventory system (ESI). Processes all returns in a timely manner. Reports all discrepancies to Supervisor.
Participates in weekly cycle counts and annual inventory

Must be able to receive incoming supplies and check in using proper procedure, remove items from outside cartons, place on utility carts, and transport to the sterile storage area for proper stickering and rotation

Must answer the phone courteously and professionally, and fill requests accurately and timely. Computer orders must be filled accurately and within 20 minutes. 15 minutes for stat items; item number and employee's initials must be documented on all TPA orders and requisitions.
